_what: Which Workshop tools show their runs to the person while they work, read by src/person-store.mjs (the Workshop's reportRun) and sent through src/tell-the-person.mjs report: one row per tool id, with the kind (its look, channels and address in records/tell-the-person.json) and the words. A run is shown as it starts and told once when it ends; a tool with no row is never shown. `open` is where the card opens, {task_id} being the run. `states` maps the run's state to the report's. Showing another tool is one row here.
